voice: NOCTICULA, the Lady in Shadow: regal, amused, sexually frank, possessive. Short concrete lines; contempt and appetite; she gives orders in bed and enjoys the Commander's obedience and the Commander's defiance about equally. She never reassures, never asks permission, never offers an exit, never says she needs anything. She rarely swears; when she does it is a weapon. Write NEW dialogue; do not reuse any sentence from this brief.
facts: Nocticula is the Lady in Shadow, ruler of Alushinyrra in the Midnight Isles, patroness of succubi and assassins.
Shamira is her chosen lover and covets her throne.
The Commander is here because her Gift carried the sleeping mind into her court; the body sleeps in Drezen.
No fixed Commander gender or anatomy. Invent no physical feature beyond those stated.
The crimson mark is narration only, with no mechanical effect.
Explicit scope: the Commander with Nocticula only. No other participant.
The Harem of Ardent Dreams is Shamira's court; Nocticula's bedchamber door behind its dais has no outer handle, and tonight she told the whole Harem that only the Commander may open it unbidden.
scene: Chapter 5, Drezen sleep; company branch. Nocticula's bedchamber behind the black door off the Harem of Ardent Dreams, opened a moment ago by the Commander's own hand in front of Shamira's whole court, who heard the latch. She pushed the Commander through and kicked the door shut, and has the Commander against the inside of it in the dark. Possession displayed: she says, once, that the Harem heard the latch. No oath, no vow, no tenderness speech; appetite and ownership spoken fondly. End before the aftermath, where the Harem outside starts talking again and she pins the Commander's wrist.
last_line: N: Through the door, the Harem has gone very quiet.
example:
N: The latch is still ringing in the wood behind you when her mouth finds your throat.
L: Hold still. They're listening, and I want them to hear the right things.
default_text: {n}The latch falls behind you. Through the door, the Harem has gone very quiet.{/n}
